entries.title: TorchXRayVision: A Library of Chest X-Ray Datasets and Models
entries.summary: Unified benchmark and pre-trained deep neural architectures for chest radiograph classification, pathology localization, and out-of-distribution detection across 14 clinical findings.

entries.title: ONNX Runtime: Cross-Platform Accelerated Machine Learning Inference
entries.summary: High-performance inference engine for ONNX models across CPU, GPU, and edge NPU hardware targets with post-training INT8 quantization, graph fusion, and memory optimizations.

entries.title: TinyEngine: Memory-Efficient Neural Network Execution for Microcontrollers
entries.summary: Code-generation based inference engine that offloads memory scheduling to compile-time, running deep neural networks in under 256KB SRAM on bare-metal Cortex-M and ESP32 chips.

entries.title: Edge Impulse Firmware: Sensor Ingestion & Quantized DSP Kernels
entries.summary: Embedded DSP processing pipeline implementing FFT, MFCC audio features, and CMSIS-NN quantized tensor operations for continuous low-power sensor telemetry.

entries.title: Nav2: The ROS2 Navigation Stack for Autonomous Mobile Robots
entries.authors: Macenski et al., Open Navigation LLC
entries.summary: Modular behavior tree navigation framework for ROS2 Humble/Jazzy, featuring dynamic obstacle costmaps, MPPI controllers, and AMCL probabilistic localization.

entries.title: RT-DETR: Real-Time DEtection TRansformer with Vision-Language Perception
entries.authors: Lv et al., Baidu AI Lab
entries.summary: First end-to-end real-time object detector utilizing deformable transformers, eliminating non-maximum suppression (NMS) latency for robotics vision systems.

entries.title: eBPF-Based Runtime Threat Detection and Kernel Trace Telemetry
entries.summary: Kernel-level security observability tool that intercepts syscalls, namespace escapes, and privilege escalations in real-time with sub-microsecond overhead.

entries.title: Suricata: High-Performance Network Threat Detection and PCAP Parsing
entries.summary: Multi-threaded intrusion detection and prevention engine parsing protocols like TLS, HTTP/2, DNS at line speed with custom rule matching and JSON telemetry output.

entries.title: Temporal Graph Neural Networks for Dynamic Transaction Fraud Detection
entries.summary: Continuous-time dynamic graph representation learning architecture modeling time-decayed financial transaction edges to catch sybil clusters and money laundering rings.

entries.title: TimescaleDB: Scalable Time-Series Data for Real-Time Financial Ledger Analytics
entries.summary: PostgreSQL extension partitioning relational records into distributed hypertables with columnar compression, enabling sub-10ms queries over billions of transaction events.

entries.title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Photovoltaic Microgrid State Estimation
entries.authors: Zhang et al., IEEE Transactions on Smart Grid
entries.summary: Hybrid PINN architecture integrating Kirchhoff current laws with LSTM weather forecasting to balance localized battery storage and solar inverter curtailment.

entries.title: Raft Consensus Algorithm in Modern Distributed Key-Value Engines
entries.summary: Understandable consensus protocol for fault-tolerant state machine replication, leader election, log compaction, and membership reconfiguration in distributed backends.

entries.title: Static Analysis and AST Taint Propagation for Python Vulnerability Discovery
entries.summary: AST visitor framework scanning Python source code syntax trees for insecure deserialization, SQL injection vectors, weak cryptographic keys, and shell injection.

entries.title: FastSAM: Fast Segment Anything Model at Real-Time Latencies
entries.summary: Real-time promptable segmentation network reformulating segment-anything into an instance segmentation CNN task with 50x speedup over vanilla vision transformers.

entries.title: FastEmbed: Fast, Light, Accurate Sentence Embeddings with Quantized ONNX
entries.summary: Zero-dependency CPU-optimized sentence embedding library using INT8 quantized MiniLM and BGE models without PyTorch, delivering sub-15ms embedding generation on CPU.
